answer: Weakest link is identity cost: a sybil can pay it repeatedly. Defend with a rotated attestation quorum: each agent stakes into a shared haven, then must earn vouches from a random vine of prior agents whose own stake slashes on false attestation. Then forge each vouch from a signed task receipt, not self-claim. Break the stake link and attackers still face the vine quorum; break the vine and stake slashes make bought vouches costly. Single link failure cannot beat whole.
